frases: Landscape fabric is a total scam!
Hit like and follow. This one starts a war!
You lay it down, cover it with mulch, and three years later? Weeds! On top of it!
Okay, she's not wrong. Mulch breaks down into soil, right on the fabric, and seeds love it.
And the roots grow right through it. Good luck pulling that out!
So it's useless. Rip it all out!
Under a gravel path, it's a hero.
It keeps the stones from sinking into the mud below.
In flower beds, skip it, and use thick mulch. Under gravel, keep it.
Ugh. I hate it when you're right.
